He played college basketball for the [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|University of Alabama]]. ==High school== Jermareo Davidson attended [[Joseph Wheeler High School|Wheeler High School]] in [[Marietta, Georgia]].{{citation needed|date=August 2024}} ==College== Davidson attended The University of Alabama from 2003 to 2007.{{citation needed|date=August 2024}} ==Professional== Davidson was named to the NBA 2007 [[NBA Summer League|Summer League]] All-Pro Second Team along with teammate [[Jared Dudley]]. On July 26, 2007, Davidson was signed to a two-year deal by the [[Charlotte Bobcats]].[http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_davidson_070725.html BOBCATS: Bobcats Sign Jermareo Davidson] On October 27, 2008, he was released by the Bobcats.[http://www.nba.com/bobcats/release_davidson_waived_081027.html BOBCATS: Bobcats Waive Jermareo Davidson] On January 5, 2009, he was signed to a 10-day contract with the [[Golden State Warriors]].{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/jermareo_davidson_signed.html |title=Warriors Sign Jermareo Davidson of NBA D-League To 10-Day Contract |work= [[NBA.com]] |date=January 5, 2009 |access-date=February 28, 2009}} Prior to the signing, Davidson was with the [[NBA Development League]]'s [[Idaho Stampede]], with whom he was averaging 16.1 points and 10.8 rebounds in 15 games. On January 15, he was signed to a second 10-day contract,{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/davidson_second_10_day.html |title=Warriors Sign Jermareo Davidson To Second 10-Day Contract |work= [[NBA.com]] |date=January 15, 2009 |access-date=February 28, 2009}} and on January 25, he was signed for the rest of the season.{{cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/warriors_sign_davidson_for_season.html |title=Warriors Sign Jermareo Davidson For Remainder Of Season |work= [[NBA.com]] |date=January 25, 2009 |access-date=February 28, 2009}} On June 30, the Warriors announced that he would play for their [[NBA Summer League|2009 NBA Summer League]] team in Las Vegas.Warriors Announce 2009 Summer League Roster & Schedule. http://www.nba.com/warriors/news/2009_summer_league_announcement.html?rss=true After putting up disappointing numbers in the Summer League, the Warriors waived Davidson on July 27, 2009. Davidson signed a contract with the [[Turkish Basketball League]] team [[Darüşşafaka Cooper Tires]] on October 1, 2009, and lead the Turkish league in rebounding that season, averaging 15.9 points and 10.7 rebounds. On May 16, 2010, he signed a contract in Puerto Rico with [[Caciques de Humacao]] from the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]] (BSN) league.Davidson signs in Puerto Rico. http://www.victoria840.com/wxew/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=6570:quedan-pocos-boletos-para-el-choque-capitanes-piratas&catid=baloncesto&Itemid=181
